sensor: Uncooled microbolometer 384x288, 17um pixel pitch, NETD <=30mK, 8-14um spectral range
features: Explosion-proof thermal positioning camera, 316L stainless steel (electro-polished welded assemblies, mirror-finish sun shield)
ATEX / IECEx: II 2 G Ex db IIB+H2, II 2 D Ex tb IIIC; Zone 1 certified
Class I, II, III Division 1 Groups B, C, D, E, F, G, cFMus approved
Radiometric: -40 to 550 C detect range, accuracy +/-2 C (<=150 C) / +/-15% (>150 C), 10 polygonal ROI zones, spot temperature
Temperature alarm option, temperature change and tank level detection
AI object detection (person, vehicle), BestShot, virtual line/area analytics
Color palettes: Whitehot, Blackhot, Rainbow, Rainbow2, Sepia, Red, Iron, Custom (hybrid palettes)
Audio in (selectable mic/line in) + line out
TPM 2.0 (FIPS 140-2 level 2), secure boot, signed/encrypted firmware
ONVIF Profile S/G/T/M, SUNAPI, MQTT, Direct Cloud Connection

frigate.notes: Hanwha profiles: profile1=MJPEG, profile2=main, profile3=sub (default Wisenet profile layout); not yet verified on this model.

release_notes: Specs per official Hanwha Vision datasheet (DataSheet_TNU-C3032A1WT1-M_20251001_EN_111800.pdf), marked "Preliminary Version". Power consumption, weight and audio/stream codec per profile are not stated and omitted. Resolution recorded as the 384x288 thermal core; the encoder also offers 768x576. Datasheet lists "Direct Cloud Connection: Support", hence cloud-optional.
